items.title: Real-World Sensors in Unity
items.summary: Did you know you can bring real-world data into Unity using IoT (Internet of Things) sensors? Sarah from the Pro Training team makes a triumphant return to the show to demonstrate how she solved her plant woes by feeding real-time soil moisture, humidity, temperature, and light (lux) values into a video game. Yes, the plant is real. And yes, it's still alive (for now).
